rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for morality as right and wrong or morally good conduct.

example.english: Having morality is what earns people's respect.
example.traditional: 做人有道德，先至會贏得人哋尊重。
example.jyutping: zou6 jan4 jau5 dou6 dak1 sin1 zi3 wui5 jeng4 dak1 jan4 dei6 zyun1 zung6

rows.note: Use this for a person's guiding beliefs or general view about how people should behave.

example.english: Our morality is different, so our views on marriage are naturally different.
example.traditional: 我哋兩個道德觀唔同，對婚姻嘅睇法自然唔一樣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou6 dak1 gun1 m4 tung4 deoi3 fan1 jan1 ge3 tai2 faat3 zi6 jin4 m4 jat1 joeng6

rows.note: Use this when morality means the social rules and standards that define acceptable conduct.

example.english: The company has established clear standards of morality and requires employees to treat customers fairly.
example.traditional: 公司訂立咗清晰嘅道德規範，要求員工公平對待客戶。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ding3 lap6 zo2 cing1 sik1 ge3 dou6 dak1 kwai1 faan6 jiu1 kau4 jyun4 gung1 gung1 ping4 deoi3 doi6 haak3 wu6
